# Platform API reference

Routes under `/api/admin`, for running PayLink itself. Authenticate with a platform key: `Authorization: Bearer pdk_…`; each route needs the capability shown. Guide: [platform API](../automation/platform-api.md).

OpenAPI document: [platform.json](pathname:///openapi/platform.json). Every PayLink also serves it at `/docs/api/platform/openapi.json`, with Swagger UI at `/docs/api`.

## /dashboard

### `GET /api/admin/dashboard`

Platform counts: tenants, admins, approvals, keys, and live payments in the last 7 days.

## /tenants

### `GET /api/admin/tenants`

Tenants in this key's reach; q searches name, address and LoginLink organization.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | string |   |
| `take` | query | integer int32 |   |

### `POST /api/admin/tenants`

Creates a tenant for an existing LoginLink organization. Needs Tenants and LoginLink.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |
| `slug` | string |  |
| `loginLink` | object |  |
| `loginLink.organization` | string |  |
| `loginLink.clientId` | string |  |
| `loginLink.clientSecret` | string |  |
| `database` | object | Mode sqlite, auto or byo; for byo, Engine mysql (default) or postgresql and its connection string. |
| `database.mode` | string |  |
| `database.connectionString` | string |  |
| `database.engine` | string |  |

### `GET /api/admin/tenants/{id}`

One tenant.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer int64 | required  |

### `PATCH /api/admin/tenants/{id}`

Suspends ("suspended") or reactivates ("active") a tenant.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer int64 | required  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | string |  |

### `GET /api/admin/tenants/{id}/keys`

A tenant's keys (secret keys for /api/v1, developer keys for /api/tenant). Secrets are never listed.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer int64 | required  |

### `POST /api/admin/tenants/{id}/keys`

Creates a key for a tenant, e.g. to hand a product built on PayLink its own sk_ key, or a tdk_ key with chosen capabilities.
The secret is returned once. Recorded in the tenant's and the platform's audit logs.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer int64 | required  |

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  |
| `kind` | string |  |
| `livemode` | boolean |  |
| `capabilities` | array of string |  |
| `expires_at` | string |  |

### `DELETE /api/admin/tenants/{id}/keys/{keyId}`

Revokes one of a tenant's keys.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer int64 | required  |
| `keyId` | path | integer int64 | required  |

## /auto-provisioning

### `GET /api/admin/auto-provisioning/approvals`

LoginLink organizations approved for an auto-provisioned database at signup.

### `POST /api/admin/auto-provisioning/approvals`

Approves an organization for an auto-provisioned database at signup.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `organization` | string |  |
| `note` | string |  |

### `DELETE /api/admin/auto-provisioning/approvals/{organization}`

Removes an approval.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `organization` | path | string | required  |

## /audit

### `GET /api/admin/audit`

The platform audit log, newest first.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `take` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `skip` | query | integer int32 |   |
